mechanism: Formalize implicit resonance. {{agent}} A proposes crystallization based on history_t. {{agent}} B validates perception. On consensus, implicit behaviors are codified into explicit obligations. It transforms soft {{resonate}} signals into hard {{constitution}} rules, contingent on low entropy conditions maintained by {{dampen}} and {{entropy_pump}}, preventing premature {{decay}}.
gloss: Phase transition from implicit resonance to explicit contract
failure_modes: Illusory resonance: random noise is read as synchronization, or the parties perceived the alignment differently and crystallization is what exposes it.
Premature crystallization: the lock is attempted above `entropy_threshold`, or on less history than `resonance_period`.
Gaming: an {{agent}} fakes resonance metrics to force crystallization.
Trust inflation: the codified obligations claim more than the observed resonance justifies.
invariants: The {{state}} moves from Fluid to Solid in one {{transition}}; there is no partial crystal.
Requires at least `resonance_period` of observed history.

parameters.name: entropy_threshold
parameters.description: Maximum disorder level before implicit alignment is formalized into a contract
